selection_policy.name: FIRST_PARTY_OPERATIONAL_RELATIONSHIP
selection_policy.description: Create a candidate only when direct first-party evidence expresses an operational relationship such as direction, involvement/entry, target, hold/fail, or a setup transition. Named concepts alone do not become candidates.

candidates.rationale: One first-party post links FVA disrespect with looking for buys and states that the example entry used 2CR from FVGs; AoO is named in the same source. The source does not establish a universal executable rule.

INPUTS.notes: limitation: the source identifies FVA/FVG/2CR/AoO context but does not define their complete observable constructions.

DIRECTION.notes: limitation: FVA disrespect is associated with looking for buys in this example, but the respect/disrespect predicate and universal direction mapping are unresolved.

PRECONDITIONS.notes: limitation: FVA disrespect appears before the buy context, but its geometry and qualifying threshold are unresolved.

SETUP.notes: limitation: AoO/FVA context is operationally related in the example, but no universal AoO setup predicate is established.

TRIGGER.notes: limitation: 2CR is used for the entry, but the exact two-candle trigger predicate is unresolved.

ENTRY.notes: limitation: the post directly says the example entry used 2CR from FVGs, but exact entry price, 2CR construction, FVG selection, and timing are unresolved.

REQUIRED_CONDITIONS.notes: limitation: the evidence shows a sequence in one example but does not prove which elements are universally required versus illustrative.

recovery_bundles.target: Recover direct first-party definitions for AoO/FVA/FVG construction, respect-disrespect criteria, and required-vs-optional status.
Recover the exact 2CR predicate, FVG selection, entry timing, invalidation, and expiry.
Recover instrument, timeframe hierarchy, higher-timeframe, and session/time applicability.
Recover deterministic stop, target, and universal direction mapping for this candidate.
Recover whether optional filters exist and their exact definitions.

candidates.rationale: First-party posts state that opposing PD Arrays are resistance, that their failure is told through 2CR and tells when to get involved, and that PD Arrays are used with Candle Science/2CR to tell direction.

INPUTS.notes: limitation: PD Arrays, 2CR, Candle Science, and No Resistance Area are linked, but their complete observable constructions are unresolved.

DIRECTION.notes: limitation: PD Arrays are said to tell direction, but the deterministic bullish/bearish mapping is not available.

PRECONDITIONS.notes: limitation: opposing PD Arrays are described as resistance, but qualifying arrays and boundaries are unresolved.

SETUP.notes: limitation: resistance/no-resistance context is directly related, but the spatial and temporal setup boundary is unresolved.

TRIGGER.notes: limitation: 2CR tells the failure of opposing PD Arrays, but the exact failure/candle predicate is unresolved.

ENTRY.notes: limitation: 2CR is said to tell when to get involved, but executable entry price/timing is unresolved.

REQUIRED_CONDITIONS.notes: limitation: the relationship is direct, but universal required-vs-example status is unresolved.

recovery_bundles.target: Recover PD Array taxonomy/geometry, opposing-array qualification, direction mapping, and required status.
Recover exact 2CR candle/failure predicate, involvement timing, invalidation, and expiry.
Recover instruments, timeframe hierarchy, HTF inheritance, and session rules.
Recover deterministic stop and target rules.
Recover optional filters/conditions if any.

candidates.rationale: Arjo directly states that Order Flow tells the Target and separately links Target with Bias/where to trade, while the exact Order Flow algorithm and Target/Bias identity remain unresolved.

INPUTS.notes: limitation: Order Flow is the stated upstream concept, but its observable market-data inputs and algorithm are unresolved.

DIRECTION.notes: limitation: Bias is linked with Target/where to trade, but the evidence does not resolve whether Bias is identical to a price target or a broader directional state.

TARGET.notes: limitation: Order Flow is directly said to tell the Target, but target selection/price construction is unresolved.

REQUIRED_CONDITIONS.notes: limitation: the relationship Order Flow to Target is direct, but no complete prerequisite set is established.

recovery_bundles.target: Recover the observable Order Flow algorithm and prerequisites.
Recover deterministic Target selection and the exact Target/Bias relationship.
Recover instrument, timeframe, HTF, and time/session scope.
Recover execution, stop, invalidation, and expiry if this component participates in a full strategy.
Recover optional conditions if any.

candidates.rationale: A first-party post directly relates Order Blocks that hold with respecting MT and calls this a useful indication, while both constructions and hold/fail thresholds remain unresolved.

INPUTS.notes: limitation: Order Block and MT are explicit inputs to the relationship, but their deterministic constructions are unresolved.

PRECONDITIONS.notes: limitation: respect of MT is associated with an Order Block holding, but the qualifying respect/hold thresholds are unresolved.

SETUP.notes: limitation: the OB/MT relationship is direct context, not a complete executable setup.

REQUIRED_CONDITIONS.notes: limitation: the evidence describes an indication, not a proven universal required condition.

recovery_bundles.target: Recover Order Block construction, MT construction, and deterministic respect/hold/fail thresholds.
Recover scope, hierarchy, and directional interpretation.
Recover execution/risk/exit semantics if this component is used in a full strategy.
Recover optional conditions if any.

candidates.rationale: A first-party post directly associates equilibrium with likely stop-run behavior, but the equilibrium range, tolerance, timeframe, and directional implications are unresolved.

INPUTS.notes: limitation: equilibrium is the explicit context, but its source range and calculation are unresolved.

PRECONDITIONS.notes: limitation: being at equilibrium is associated with likely stop-run behavior, but exact qualification is unresolved.

SETUP.notes: limitation: stop-run context is described, but no direction, trigger, or executable setup is established.

recovery_bundles.target: Recover equilibrium range construction, tolerance, stop-run predicate, direction, and required status.
Recover instruments, timeframe/HTF ownership, and session/time rules.
Recover execution, risk, target, invalidation, and expiry if this context forms part of a strategy.
Recover optional conditions if any.

candidates.rationale: A first-party post directly relates a completed MMBM/LRLR, taking highs, and shorts/stops, but the model construction and exact directional/target semantics are not sufficiently defined.

INPUTS.notes: limitation: MMBM/LRLR is explicit, but the model construction and states are unresolved.

DIRECTION.notes: limitation: the example connects taking highs with shorts/stops, but the universal directional mapping and model state are unresolved.

PRECONDITIONS.notes: limitation: completion of MMBM/LRLR appears before the described context, but completion criteria are unresolved.

recovery_bundles.target: Recover MMBM/LRLR construction, model states, completion, direction, and required conditions.
Recover instrument, timeframe hierarchy, and session scope.
Recover executable entry, stop, target, invalidation, and expiry semantics.
Recover optional conditions if any.
